name: Box Turn (forward half)
notes: Owner's description: the basic waltz step, counts 1-2-3, a quarter turn clockwise while progressing forward; lead starts forward on the right foot, the feet close on 3, and the turn is felt mostly on 2. Usually followed by Box Turn (backward half). Step sizes and rise are assumptions the owner accepted for now (2026-11-16): 0.5 forward, then the left foot lands 0.4 beyond the right in the turned frame; no rise. The whole quarter turn is placed on step 2. Step 2 is 'side' in the turned frame, but offsets are measured from the facing before the turn, so the left foot travels from beside the right heel to 0.4 past the right foot: 0.9 forward and 0.2 right. Exempt from the "partner spacing" and "crossed feet" checks (added 2026-11-16): early in count 2 the follow's right foot passes within 15 cm of the lead's standing right foot, and her feet cross briefly, because she has to travel round to end in front of him and the model's closed hold puts her directly in front of him rather than slightly to his right. No split of the turn between counts fixes it; the fix (an offset closed hold, or a curved path round the back for her) is waiting on the owner's decision. Remove skipChecks once it's fixed.
